As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to ensure you are informed about how we collect,\\r\\nprocess, and protect your personal data when you use certain services. \\u003c/p\\u003e\\u003cp style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:8px;margin-top:24px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700\\\"\\u003eWhat’s Changing?\\u003c/p\\u003e\\u003cp style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:10px\\\"\\u003e Artificial intelligence (“AI”) continues to evolve rapidly, creating new opportunities to improve how job seekers and employers connect. We are updating our Privacy Policy to reflect our latest AI features and tools, offering clearer insights into how these technologies function across our\\r\\nplatform. \\u003c/p\\u003e\\u003cp style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:10px\\\"\\u003e You can read the full policy whenever you like, but here’s a quick look at the most important changes: \\u003c/p\\u003e\\u003cul style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:10px;padding-left:24px\\\"\\u003e\\u003cli style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:8px\\\"\\u003e \\u003cstrong\\u003eBetter Matching:\\u003c/strong\\u003e We utilize machine learning algorithms and better AI models to help improve our matching of job seekers with relevant job opportunities and recommending qualified candidates to employers. \\u003c/li\\u003e\\u003cli style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:8px\\\"\\u003e\\r\\n\\u003cstrong\\u003eNew Helpful AI Features:\\u003c/strong\\u003e We’re constantly adding new AI tools to make things easier. For example, we now connect with tools like ChatGPT and Claude to help you search for jobs on those platforms. We also incorporate AI tools to assist job seekers with enhancing their profile, resume or application, as well as features to help employers generate job descriptions and screening questions based on job requirements. \\u003c/li\\u003e\\u003cli style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:8px\\\"\\u003e \\u003cstrong\\u003ePersonal Data\\r\\nProcessing:\\u003c/strong\\u003e We’ve added a dedicated section that explains how personal data is processed using AI. \\u003c/li\\u003e\\u003cli style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:8px\\\"\\u003e \\u003cstrong\\u003eInternal Operations:\\u003c/strong\\u003e We use AI behind the scenes to help optimize our operational efficiency and allow us to continually improve upon the services we provide to you. \\u003c/li\\u003e\\u003c/ul\\u003e\\u003cp style\\u003d\\\"margin-bottom:10px\\\"\\u003e \\u003cstrong\\u003eImportant Note on Hiring Decisions:\\u003c/strong\\u003e Please note that AI tools are designed to facilitate and streamline the job\\r\\nsearch and recruitment process.
